## Workflow and source

Describe the task, author, license, repository/directory and changed behavior.

## Compatibility evidence

List tested clients/versions, dependencies, example prompts and expected results.
Include at least one prompt that should not invoke the skill.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Metadata, resource references and source checks pass.
- [ ] Instructions and every script/resource are available for human review.
- [ ] License permits redistribution and preserves asset attribution.
- [ ] No credentials, private fonts or automatic install hooks are included.
- [ ] New/updated sources are pinned to a full commit with an archive checksum.
- [ ] Bundled names and canonical skills are preserved.
